text: Assumption: Parallel invocations without external synchronization are permissible based on the property \"thread-safe\" — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Parallel invocations without external synchronization are permissible based on the property \"thread-safe\" — is this correct?
norm: parallel invocations without external synchronization are permissible based on the property thread safe
assumption: Parallel invocations without external synchronization are permissible based on the property \"thread-safe\".
rationale: The specification guarantees thread safety, but formulates no additional synchronization requirements for the caller.

original.text: Annahme: Aus der Eigenschaft „thread-safe“ wird abgeleitet, dass parallele Aufrufe ohne externe Synchronisation zulässig sein dürften — trifft das zu?

original.rationale: Die Spezifikation garantiert Thread-Sicherheit, formuliert aber keine zusätzlichen Synchronisationsanforderungen an den Aufrufer.
